senses.gloss: (v. חָלַט II, a. Syr. חלט P. Sm. 1277) bind up, mix, esp. to stir flour in hot water, v. חֲלִיטָה II.—Part. pass. חָלוּט a paste prepared by stirring, dumpling.
units: Y. Ḥall. I, 58ᵃ top; Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵇ ח׳ ברור a real ḥalut (concerning which there is no doubt as to the obligation of Ḥallah).
Y. Ab. Zar. II, 42ᵃ top ה׳ מחוסר וכ׳ the ḥalut (prepared by a gentile) wants finishing through fire (frying or boiling); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to become consistent through stirring. Y. Ḥall. l. c. נֶחְלְטָה כל צורכה sufficiently stirred to be a consistent paste-ball.
